card.name: Words just before 'monitored' instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, be, should, comma, careful) in drug-interaction advice, right where the next word is likely 'monitor', 'monitored' or 'observed'.

modes.label: Linking word after caution
modes.description: 'and' or a comma joins a caution or low-dose instruction to a following monitoring instruction.
modes.example: These drugs should be coadministered with caution<< and>> frequent monitoring of serum lithium levels is recommended

modes.label: Before a passive monitoring verb
modes.description: 'be' or 'should' after 'patients should' leads into 'monitored' or 'observed'.
modes.example: it is recommended that patients<< be>> monitored and the haloperidol dec

modes.label: Careful before observation
modes.description: 'careful' precedes 'observation' of the patient when two drugs are used together.
modes.example: If concomitant treatment of fluvoxamine with a triptan is clinically warranted,<< careful>> observation of the patient is advised, particularly

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce the word monitor/monitoring/observed next and away from correction-type words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a drug-interaction label says the patient should be monitored.
